text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S was asked a question by 
Zenno Rob Roy: Why did she choose the Aoba 
Sho as her prep race for the Nippon Derby?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No Umamusume who won the Aoba Sho has ever 
conquered the Nippon Derby. This "Aoba Sho 
Jinx" is well known.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Symboli Kris S explained that she 
had decided after considering various 
factors. What mattered was delivering 
"results," regardless of jinxes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the day of the Aoba Sho arrived. 
Symboli Kris S headed into the race with 
her usual determination to deliver 
"results."
